interpretation: Completed sensitivity evidence, not new causal identification. Conditional HAC intervals omit generated-shock uncertainty; residual Wald tests are asymptotic and high-dimensional; Monte Carlo evidence is synthetic. Municipal effects remain unavailable.

lp.boundary: Same baseline generated shocks; conditional HAC omits shock-estimation uncertainty. Lag augmentation alone does not certify the cited uniform-inference theorem. Not independent identification.

residuals.caution: HAC asymptotic auxiliary Wald diagnostics with generated residuals; small sample/model selection can distort size. Not an exact small-sample system test or causal validation.
residuals.seasonal_null: equal quarter-specific mean squared residuals (seasonal volatility screen), not a repeat test of fitted quarter means
residuals.serial_null: all lagged residual-vector coefficients zero in each auxiliary equation, retaining its original regressors

saved_draws.boundary: Cumulative response starts at impact (h=0). Draw-wise nonlinear conversion; inherits baseline identification/VAR bootstrap. Not simultaneous bands.
saved_draws.unit_shock: responses per +1 percentage point FDI/GDP innovation; normalize each draw by its own impact

simulation.boundary: Small designed benchmark, not proof of correct coverage for Brazil. Three variables, no municipal data. Report failures separately. This benchmark does not implement the full municipal parallel-trends sensitivity study.
